description: Fetch full metadata for 1-20 records in one call, by recid, DOI, CMS dataset path (/Primary/Era/TIER) or documentation slug. Returns the description, run periods, collision and distribution details, related records, a software-environment summary, the license and a ready citation, plus what a record states of its variable dictionary, physics category, pile-up, keywords, and LHCb magnet polarity and stripping. Documentation and news pages include their markdown body in slices of at most 30,000 characters; body_offset with that one id reads on from where a slice stops. Each response holds to 64,000 bytes: records past it are left out whole and listed under deferred, to pass back as ids. File lists are not included; use cern_opendata_list_files. Identifiers that do not resolve come back under missing with guidance; they do not fail the call.

body_offset.description: With exactly one documentation or news id: where its body slice starts, in characters (UTF-16 code units), usually the body_next_offset an earlier call returned. 0 (the default) is the body's start and is accepted with any ids; above 0 needs exactly one id.

ids.description: Identifiers to resolve, 1-20: an array, or one comma-separated string. Forms may be mixed; duplicates collapse.

items.description: One identifier: a recid (6004 or atlas-160006, recid:6004 or a portal record URL), a DOI (10.7483/OPENDATA.CMS.YLIC.86ZZ, doi:… or a doi.org URL), a CMS dataset path (/DoubleMuParked/Run2012B-22Jan2013-v1/AOD) or a documentation slug (cms-guide-docker or its portal URL).

name: cern_opendata_get_records

deferred.description: Inputs whose records were left out to hold the response to 64,000 bytes, in input order; pass them as ids to fetch those records. Empty when every resolved record is returned.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_body_offset`: body_offset is above 0 beside two or more ids, or at or past the body_length of the record its one id names, or that record has no body. `rate_limited`: The portal's 60-a-minute budget is spent: it answered 429, or the request could not start within the call's deadline. data.retryAfter is set. `upstream_unreadable`: The portal answered with a body the server could not read: not JSON, missing the expected envelope, or over the byte ceiling (then data.retryable is false). Also raised when a search answers 404. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

missing.description: Identifiers that resolved to no record; empty when every id resolved.

items.description: One identifier that did not resolve.

guidance.description: Why it did not resolve and how to find the record.

interpreted_as.description: The identifier form it was read as; unrecognized when no form fits.

notice.description: Caveats about the returned records: a documentation body with more to read, or records deferred by the response budget, each with the call that continues it.

records.description: Resolved records, in the order of their first matching input.

items.description: One record with its metadata, license and citation; file lists are not included.

abstract_html.description: Abstract, HTML as the portal sent it.

authors.description: Authors; a news page author string becomes one entry.

orcid.description: ORCID iD, when the record states one.

availability.description: Record-level availability: online, partial, ondemand or requested.

availability_details.description: File counts by availability state (online, on demand), as the portal reports them.

on_demand.description: Files on tape, requested on the record's portal page before download.

body.description: Docs and news: the page body (markdown), at most 30,000 characters (UTF-16 code units) from body_offset.

body_format.description: Docs and news: body format, such as md.

body_length.description: Docs and news: length of the whole body in characters (UTF-16 code units).

body_next_offset.description: Docs and news: where the rest of the body starts, present only when more follows; pass it as body_offset with this id alone to continue.

body_offset.description: Docs and news: where this body slice starts in the whole body; 0 for its start.

body_truncated.description: Docs and news: true when more body follows this slice (see body_next_offset).

primary.description: Physics category, such as Standard Model Physics or Higgs, exactly as stored (the search category filter).

secondary.description: Subcategories, such as Top physics; empty when none.

source.description: Who assigned the category, when stated.

citation.description: Citation; present only when the record has a DOI.

text.description: Ready citation built from the record fields.

collaboration.description: The collaboration that released the record.

recid.description: Record id of the collaboration page.

collections.description: Portal collections, exact and case-sensitive (the search collection filter).

collision_type.description: Collision type, such as pp or PbPb.

dataset_semantics.description: Pages describing the dataset variables, on the portal; a record with an inline dictionary carries variables instead.

distribution.description: Distribution summary: formats, events, files and size.

formats.description: File formats and data tiers, such as aod or nanoaod; empty when none.

items.description: One file format or data tier.

experiment.description: Experiments, such as CMS or ATLAS.

id.description: Portal id: the recid for records, the slug for documentation and news.

keywords.description: Keywords, case as stored (the search keywords filter).

kind.description: doc for documentation and news pages (they carry a slug), record otherwise.

basis.description: record: stated on the record; cern_terms_default: a Dataset with no license of its own, CC0 under the CERN Open Data Terms of Use; not_stated: no license stated.

id.description: SPDX-style license id, such as CC0-1.0.

links.description: Links from the abstract, note, usage, validation, use_with and pile-up sections and software links; empty when none.

description.description: Link text as the portal states it; for a pile-up link, the pile-up dataset path.

source.description: The metadata section the link came from.

url.description: Linked URL; portal-relative paths start with /.

magnet_polarity.description: LHCb: magnet polarity during data taking, MagDown or MagUp.

matched_inputs.description: The requested ids that resolved to this record, as given.

methodology_html.description: Methodology, HTML as the portal sent it.

note_html.description: Notes, HTML as the portal sent it.

pileup_html.description: Simulated data: how pile-up events were mixed in, HTML as the portal sent it; the pile-up datasets are in links with source pileup.

portal_url.description: The record or documentation page on opendata.cern.ch.

recid.description: Record id: digits (6004), or an experiment prefix and digits (atlas-160006); absent on docs and news.

relations.description: Related records, relayed verbatim; empty when none.

type.description: Relation type as the portal states it (isParentOf, isChildOf, isRelatedTo); the portal applies it inconsistently.

run_numbers.description: Run numbers the record covers, as strings.

short_description.description: Docs and news: the short description, as received.

slug.description: Documentation or news slug; absent on records.

stripping.description: LHCb datasets and stripping pages: the stripping stream and version.

system_details.description: Software environment summary; cern_opendata_get_analysis_env expands it.

container_images.description: Container images for the analysis environment (separately licensed).

description.description: Environment description, HTML as the portal sent it.

environment_recid.description: Record id of the environment record the portal names.

release.description: Software release, such as a CMSSW version.

title.description: Title as the portal states it.

title_additional.description: Descriptive secondary title; used in the citation when present.

type.description: Record type as the portal classifies it.

primary.description: Primary type: Dataset, Software, Environment, Documentation, Supplementaries or News. Empty when the record states none.

secondary.description: Secondary types, such as Collision or Simulated; empty when none.

usage_html.description: Usage instructions, HTML as the portal sent it.

use_with_html.description: What the record is used with, HTML as the portal sent it.

validation_html.description: Validation notes, HTML as the portal sent it.

variables.description: The variable dictionary of a derived or event-level dataset, every entry.

description_html.description: What the variable holds, HTML as the portal sent it.

type.description: Data type, such as float or std::vector<float>.

unit.description: Unit, when the record states one.

variable.description: Variable or branch name, as the portal states it.

title: Get CERN Open Data Records
